body: This is still reproducible in Godot 4.7.stable (Windows 11). After some more testing, I found that this autocompletion desyncing problem isn't just caused by `CTRL` + `Backspace`, but also other various shortcuts will cause this autocompletion desyncing issue: - `CTRL` + `Z` (Undo) - `CTRL` + `X` (Cut) - `CTRL` + `Home` (Caret document start) - `CTRL` + `Enter` (New blank line) - `CTRL` + `Left` (Caret word left) - `CTRL` + `Right` (Caret word right) - `CTRL` + `Shift` + `K` (Delete line) - `CTRL` + `Shift` + `J` (Join lines) (This requires a line to exist after the current) I also get this error (or similar) in the output when I accept the autocomplete after using these shortcuts and it desyncs (Godot 4.7.stable): `ERROR: scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:4372 - Index p_from_column = -3 is out of bounds (text[p_from_line].length() + 1 = 2).`
